A person compares the armor full of effects on a street billboard with the dull armor they received on their phone.

Footprints in the snow lead to a shop window where the armor has changed, and a broom sweeps some of them away.
The form may change. The value has to stay. <1>Conceptual illustration made with AI.</1>
A scale balances the old armor and the new one, with different designs, and a person checks the balance.
Locking someone out takes a reason. And someone on the other side. <1>Conceptual illustration made with AI.</1>

A line of people waits in front of a claw machine where the armor stays out of reach, and the mechanism is shown set to let go.
Whoever keeps the evidence has to show it. <1>Conceptual illustration made with AI.</1>
